threads.body:
This brief does not mirror the emitted metric description in `experimental-kafka-connect.yaml`: it omits both the indicator semantics and the fact that Apache and Confluent status values are supported. Weaver currently does not enforce description equality, so the new registry can pass validation while documenting a different contract. Keep the registry brief identical to the existing description.

This issue also appears on line 377 of the same file.

threads.body: `library/kafka-connect.md` still documents the old descriptions, so its table no longer matches what the instrumentation emits. Every other row in that file matches its `desc` exactly. (Same for `kafka.connect.task.status` on line 67 of that file.)
